Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the 
major maintenance procedure P1, which must be performed for Condensate pump 
every five years as indicated by Y5 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated by 
eng. Gamal Mostafa which reviewed by Maintenance 
manager eng. Mohammed Farag and Revised by Inspection and Quality Control at EDEPC. 
eng. Abouda Elbana and tested on May30, 2003. by eng. Gamal Mostafa and 
Approved by General Manager Eng. Ali Mostafa El lithy
Safety Precautions
Issue work order including the team 
work names
Wear safety helmet shoes- gloves, 
etc.
Use safety fence with caution marks 
surrounding the work area is required.
Isolate the circuit breaker of the 
pump motor
Disconnect electric terminals of the pump motor
The pump must be isolated mechanically by 
closing delivery and suction valves.
Be sure pump must be completely 
drainage.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid.Manual 
puller.
Feeler 
gauge, 
 Dial 
indicator
Vibrometer, 
Straight edge, 
 Rags.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid.Manual 
puller.
Feeler 
gauge, 
 Dial 
indicator
Vibrometer, 
Straight edge, 
 Rags.
Work to be carried out
Disassembly
Checks discharge quantity and 
 pressure and record them.
Check the vibration level of the 
 pump set complete with the motor then, record them.
Measure the pump alignment and 
 record it.
Dismount the motor after stopping 
 the pump and dismantling the electric terminals of it then, take it out.
Measure the axial clearance of the 
 pump and record it.
Dismantle the attached pipes to the 
 pump
Dismantle the pump from the 
 Condensate tank.
Raise the pump and take it to the 
 work place.
Take the cords of the stuffing box 
 out.
Unscrew the castle nut and take 
 coupling out.
Dismantle the lantern ring.
Dismount thrust bearing (29326).
Dismantle the clamping bolts of the 
 pump stages.
Dismantle the pump impellers 
 starting from suction side up to the last stage.
Dismount the guide pipe and the 
 elbow.
Dismantle the lower shaft from the 
 half coupling.
Inspection
The validity of journal bearings 
 white metal casting.
The validity of the anti-friction 
 bearings
Check the radial clearances for pump 
 by measuring the gap between wearing rings of diffusers and the distance 
 sleeves on the shaft and record it.
Check all parts for any worn-out.
Check all parts for cracks.
Inspect the run-out of shafts.
Assembly
Make sure the contact surfaces of 
 flanges and guide bearings are clean and not damaged.
Install pump impellers on the shaft 
 beginning from discharge side up to the suction side.
Fit the suction journal bearing and 
 tight all stages together with clamping bolts and Check the rotation of the 
 shaft.
Mount the first joint of the shaft 
 to the protruding top end of the pump shaft and join them rigidly by the mafe 
 coupling.
Mount the first guide pipe and fix 
 it to the pump casing.
Mount the bearing housing on the top 
 end of the first guide pipe from which the shaft protrudes.
Install the lantern ring and mount 
 stuffing box, then re-pack it.
Mount the bearing (29326) and check 
 whether the shaft has uniform play in the hole of the bearing and also whether 
 it has not deflected to one side by the bearing.
Lower the fully assembled pump on to 
 the erection frame and fix it.
Mount the pump half coupling.
Adjust the axial clearance of the 
 pump by lifting the entire rotor in the upward direction until it stops by 
 means of the castle nut. At the same time, count the number of turns of the 
 nut up to the moment when the nut is fully tightened.
Set the rotor correctly by 
 slackening the nut to half of the number of turns, which were necessary for 
 its tightening.
Secure the nut in its position by a 
 cotter pin, or with type BKN by safety screw.
Mount the electric motor on its 
 place.
Adjust the alignment between motor 
 shaft and pump shaft and record them.
Starting the Pump
Before 
starting the pump, the following steps should be checked
Check the oil level in the 
 thrust-bearing pump bath
Open the cooling water for the oil 
 bath of the thrust bearing.
Open the suction and delivery valves 
 of the pump.
Check the direction of rotation of 
 the pump by pushing the electric button of the motor pump instantaneously.
Attendance and checking during operation
During 
operation of the pump, the following should be checked:
The temperature of the anti-friction 
 bearing (it should be not exceed 75C).
The temperature of cooling water.
Any water leakage and oil leakage.
The discharge quantity and pressures 
 (suction and discharge) of the pump and record them.
Check the vibration level and record 
 it.
